```{r, getrecentobservations}

#Define ebird API key.
api_key <- Sys.getenv("api_key")

#API Call
hotspots <- request("https://api.ebird.org/v2/ref/hotspot/US-MI") |> 
  req_headers(
    `X-eBirdApiToken` = api_key,
  ) |> 
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()
```
